## Decisions

- Light-only warm paper, charcoal, and restrained blue. Text-only identity; no asterisk logo or vague human-touch slogan.
- Full-screen editorial hero, Mona Sans / IBM Plex Mono, subtle grid, sticky top navigation, and numbered chapter rail.
- Original GLB engineer and web/mobile/backend geometry with Solid/Mesh modes and accessible rotation controls. Demand-driven rendering and text fallback; never a raster avatar.
- Four featured cases use a numbered project index and a complete large case-study panel. Tall desktop screens keep the index sticky; tablet/mobile use a two-column selector grid. Six secondary projects and seven archive entries remain compact and factual.
- Borderless monochrome SVG contact icons replace the mixed PNG presentation at the user's request; original assets and destinations are preserved.
- All original project data, URLs, contacts, and resume preserved. Product visuals are illustrative studies, not deployed application screenshots.
- The supplied company site informed composition and navigation only; none of its branding, code, assets, claims, or copy was imported or added as a portfolio project.
- Reduced motion, offscreen suspension, semantic content, visible focus, safe external links, and 44px controls.
- Interface colors use semantic tokens; illustration palettes and physical lighting retain local art direction. 21st review reported informational hardcoded-color notices only.
